rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a blastocyst and acknowledges single-image limitations, but it overstates confidence in identifying a strong cohesive TE and A-grade ICM from this image, where focal plane and partial collapse make those features less clearly assessable.
Thoroughly integrates age, endometriosis, ovarian reserve markers, oocyte yield, semen parameters, endometrium, lifestyle, and first-cycle status into prognosis and transfer planning.

Reasoning is structured and mostly consistent, with probability estimates logically tied to age, morphology, and endometriosis; minor overinterpretation of morphology and some speculative comments slightly reduce rigor.

Recommendations are largely evidence-based and aligned with standard IVF practice, including single embryo transfer and caution about routine add-ons/PGT-A in a young first-cycle patient; however, a few vague adjunct suggestions are not strongly guideline-based.

Provides practical transfer and contingency recommendations, including SET, luteal support adherence, and when to reconsider endometriosis/FET/PGT-A, though some advice remains somewhat general rather than protocol-specific.
